en: Pardon me. If it isn't too much trouble, might I have a look at your Pokémon?
I'm most grateful for your cooperation!
Oh, come now. It's all in the name of science!
Oh! How very interesting! Your {lead} carries itself with more confidence than others of its kind.
And you a Trainer with only three Badges...
Fantastic! I couldn't tell you how you're doing it, but you're drawing out the power of your Pokémon!
Ah, forgive me. I'm a scientist, and my name is Colress. The subject of my research is a single question: how does one bring out a Pokémon's full power?
Is it the bond a Pokémon shares with its Trainer? Or is there some other way entirely? That's what I intend to find out.
I'd like to test my theory in a battle with you. Would you find that acceptable?
Either way, I'll be waiting for you on Route 4. It's just past the gate up ahead!
